name: Canyon Ranch Lenox
insider_take: This wellness sanctuary sits on 120 pristine acres in the heart of the Berkshire Mountains, where Tanglewood's summer symphony concerts have enchanted visitors since 1937.
whats_special: Canyon Ranch Lenox is America's original destination spa resort, pioneering the integrative wellness movement since 1989. The property features over 40 fitness classes daily, a 100,000-square-foot spa, and sits at 1,200 feet elevation offering stunning mountain vistas. The resort's farm-to-table cuisine sources ingredients from local Berkshire farms.
pro_tip: Book your stay during Tanglewood season (June-September) to enjoy world-class Boston Symphony Orchestra performances just 10 minutes away, then return for evening meditation sessions under the stars.
dont_miss: The sunrise hike to Laura's Tower for panoramic Berkshire views, and the signature "Kripalu Forest Bathing" experience. Explore nearby Norman Rockwell Museum in Stockbridge (15 minutes) or take the scenic drive to Mount Washington State Forest, home to the state's highest peak.
